mentions.body: Autonomous [Lamp](https://www.autonomous.ai/lamp) is a programmable desk robot running the open-source [lampOS](https://github.com/autonomous-ai/lampOS). It gives supported AI agents a physical interface through its camera, microphone, speaker, light and movement, and builders can examine the code and create their own skills.
mentions.disclaimer: Not tested by SkillMaxx; independent mention, not sponsored.
